claims.statement: All finite positive normalized weighted chains are identified against all finite positive normalized weighted competitors from a complete physical-time incidence germ and known population.
Equal-weight SInR is the motivating corollary for all finite true and competing orders and all positive points.
For fixed complex weights with terminal weight nonzero, every irreducible invariant variety of dimensions 2 through n with x not identically zero avoids x=0.
For positive fixed weights, every positive orbit closure contains the equilibrium line and is the full reduced state space.
For equal weights and n>=2 only nonzero scalar multiples of x^k are Darboux polynomials.

limitations: strict positivity in both physical models
